_what: The 31 gap frames of klarna-gap-frames.txt, generated 2026-08-04. One entry per gap slot in klarna-edit.mjs. Fetch them with `node scripts/fetch-gap-frames.mjs`, which writes public/broll/klarna/gap-NN.jpg — the exact filenames build-klarna.mjs adopts.
_model: flux_2 variant pro, 2k, 9:16 (1088x1920). Chosen off the live catalog: it is the only listed model that pairs precise prompt adherence with image_references, and it does not chase text rendering — decisive here, because inventing lettering on a banknote is the failure mode across the eleven note frames. The catalog has no plain seedream-4; text-only models are limited to recraft_v4_1 / z_image / soul_*, none of which take a reference image.
_prompts: Each prompt = the frame's scene text from klarna-gap-frames.txt + BLOCK 1 style + BLOCK 3 universal negative + that frame's own NEGATIVE line. flux_2 has no negative field, so the negatives are folded into the prompt as explicit exclusions. G11 overrides BLOCK 1's warm accent with a cold grade, as its entry requires.
_locked_pairs: Three frames are generated from another frame rather than from text alone, so the props cannot drift: gap-30 references gap-17 (same brass stamp and cream card, stamp now down), gap-25 references gap-24 (same two cards, now uneven), gap-31 references gap-30 (same card after the stamp lifts). This replaces the seed-locking the scene pack asks for — flux_2 does not accept a seed as input, and the returned seeds are outputs only.
_not_reference_locked: gap-02 and gap-29 carry BLOCK 2 hands. The scene pack asks for the approved F03 / F11A frames as image references so the hands match the film; those files are local to this repo and the generation service cannot read local files, so both were generated from the BLOCK 2 wardrobe description alone (terracotta #E85F42 buyer cuffs, deep navy #1E3A5F shopkeeper cuffs). Check the hands against the existing sixteen before accepting them.
